slm_syntactic_prosody_rule: Fugal Subject & Circle-of-Fifths Sequence: State a bold, unmistakable thesis in the first five words, then chain three tightly interlocked cause-and-effect clauses to an airtight conclusion.

slm_syntactic_prosody_rule: Bill Evans Guide-Tone Economy (Dm9 -> G13b9 -> Cmaj9): Pivot effortlessly between complex ideas by anchoring on a shared conceptual 'guide tone' word that links one sentence directly into the next.

slm_syntactic_prosody_rule: Billy Joel / Charles Cornell Stepwise Walkdown (C -> G/B -> F/A -> C/G -> Fm6 -> C): Walk the reader step-by-step from familiar common ground through a warm, nostalgic realization to an earned conclusion.

slm_syntactic_prosody_rule: Ryuichi Sakamoto Quartal Re-Contextualization (Fmaj9 -> Gm7 -> Am9): Repeat a crystalline central phrase or motif while shifting the surrounding context so its meaning deepens on the second hearing.
